lines: Zindagi hi mein maqamat badal jaate hain
couplets.en: Even within a lifetime, our stations change.

lines: Dekhte dekhte haalat badal jaate hain

lines: Hum wahi, tum bhi wahi, aur ye duniya bhi wahi

lines: Farq itna hai, khayalat badal jaate hain
